programmes.d: After Emilio's deported, Jackie steps up and creates a birth plan for Becky.
Darlene struggles to decide between David and Ben; Becky begins to doubt herself as a mom.
Harris is forced to confront Darlene about her lifestyle; Becky’s overwhelmed by the costs of raising a baby.
Becky applies for a bartending job at Casita Bonita; Dan is concerned it could worsen her drinking.
At Halloween, Jackie learns a shocking secret while trying to reopen the Lunch Box.
Jackie and Becky pitch Darlene their business plan hoping to get the Lunch Box reopened.
Chaos ensues when Dan finally gets the whole family together for Thanksgiving; Harris makes an unexpected move
Jackie’s faced with a tough decision that brings the family and community together.
Dan is disappointed when everyone but Becky forgets about his birthday; Darlene faces another issue.
The Conners struggle to accept Becky's new boyfriend, a big Packers fan.
Darlene’s thrilled when Harris gets into Central Illinois State, but she may have other plans.
The Conners share their opinions on voting; Louise gets an offer that could take her away from Lanford.
Dan avoids coping with a death, only to be faced with it head-on; Ben and Darlene address his baby fever.
Dan begins to bond with his younger half-brother but is angry their dad paid for Ed Jr.'s college education.
Darlene gets a job at Price Warehouse; Ben shaves his beard to look more clean-cut to advertisers.
